cases.case_label: SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (XDP): blood TAF1 splicing biomarkers
cases.mechanism_detail: The intron 32 SVA causes alternative splicing (disease-specific TAF1-32i variant) and reduced TAF1 expression 3' to the insertion; patient NPCs, their extracellular vesicles and whole blood show a lower TAF1-3'/5' ratio and higher TAF1-32i.
cases.quote: A retrotransposon inserted in intron 32 of the TAF1 gene leads to alternative splicing in the region and a reduction of the full‐length mRNA transcript.
